title: Lung Cancer
subtitle: StewardMD ONCOTREE navigator (draft)
provenanceNote: ONCOTREE navigator DRAFT for lung cancer (NSCLC, SCLC, malignant pleural mesothelioma). Nodes capture the physician-entered phenotype (histology, clinical scenario/stage, and for metastatic NSCLC the actionable driver then PD-L1) and route to APPLICABLE existing StewardMD Standard Protocols by reference. Histology (squamous vs non-squamous) is matched so pemetrexed-based regimens are not surfaced for squamous disease. Driver hierarchy (EGFR/ALK before PD-L1/chemo-immunotherapy) is encoded structurally. matchDisease is false because the existing lung protocols carry drifted diseaseId tags (nsclc vs neoplasms_of_the_lung); the per-node protocolRefs are the authoritative scope. The navigator invents no dose, no regimen, and no eligibility criterion. Structural pathway consistent with Standard Guidelines (NCCN) NSCLC/SCLC/Mesothelioma; no proprietary content reproduced. DRAFT - not clinically activated; physician decides.
sourceNote: Structural pathway consistent with Standard Guidelines (NCCN), NSCLC / SCLC / Mesothelioma. Treatment options reference existing StewardMD Standard Protocols and their own evidence layers.

nodes.name: Histology
nodes.title: Confirmed histology
nodes.description: Histology drives the entire lung pathway: NSCLC subtype (squamous vs non-squamous) changes the chemotherapy backbone; small-cell and mesothelioma follow distinct pathways.

nodes.name: Clinical scenario
nodes.title: NSCLC clinical scenario
nodes.description: Select the clinical scenario. Resectable early-stage and unresectable stage III are curative-intent; metastatic disease is palliative and driven by molecular testing.

nodes.name: Actionable driver
nodes.title: Actionable molecular driver
nodes.description: In metastatic NSCLC, test for actionable drivers before immunotherapy/chemotherapy. An EGFR sensitizing mutation or ALK rearrangement directs targeted therapy first.

nodes.name: PD-L1 expression
nodes.title: PD-L1 tumour proportion score
nodes.description: For driver-negative metastatic NSCLC, PD-L1 expression guides single-agent immunotherapy vs chemo-immunotherapy.

nodes.name: Resectable NSCLC chemotherapy
nodes.title: Resectable NSCLC: platinum-doublet chemotherapy
nodes.description: Peri-operative platinum-doublet chemotherapy, matched to histology (pemetrexed only in non-squamous). Physician selects; the existing dose engine computes doses.

nodes.name: Unresectable stage III NSCLC
nodes.title: Unresectable stage III: chemoradiation + consolidation
nodes.description: Definitive concurrent platinum-doublet chemoradiation, followed by durvalumab consolidation in non-progressors. Histology matches the chemotherapy backbone. Physician selects.

nodes.name: EGFR-targeted therapy
nodes.title: EGFR-mutant metastatic NSCLC: targeted therapy
nodes.description: EGFR sensitizing mutation - a first-line EGFR tyrosine-kinase inhibitor is preferred over chemotherapy or immunotherapy. Physician selects.

nodes.name: ALK-targeted therapy
nodes.title: ALK-rearranged metastatic NSCLC: targeted therapy
nodes.description: ALK rearrangement - a first-line ALK tyrosine-kinase inhibitor is preferred over chemotherapy or immunotherapy. Physician selects.

nodes.name: PD-L1-high immunotherapy
nodes.title: Driver-negative, PD-L1 high: immunotherapy options
nodes.description: Driver-negative metastatic NSCLC with PD-L1 TPS >= 50%: single-agent pembrolizumab or chemo-immunotherapy, matched to histology. Physician selects.

nodes.name: Chemo-immunotherapy
nodes.title: Driver-negative, PD-L1 low: chemo-immunotherapy
nodes.description: Driver-negative metastatic NSCLC with PD-L1 TPS < 50%: platinum chemo-immunotherapy, matched to histology (KEYNOTE-189 non-squamous, KEYNOTE-407 squamous). Physician selects.

nodes.name: SCLC stage
nodes.title: SCLC stage
nodes.description: Small cell lung cancer stage guides therapy: limited-stage (chemoradiation-eligible) vs extensive-stage (chemo-immunotherapy) vs relapsed.

nodes.name: Limited-stage SCLC
nodes.title: Limited-stage SCLC: platinum-etoposide
nodes.description: Platinum-etoposide chemotherapy, given with concurrent thoracic radiotherapy in limited-stage disease. Physician selects.

nodes.name: Extensive-stage SCLC
nodes.title: Extensive-stage SCLC: platinum-etoposide + immunotherapy
nodes.description: Platinum-etoposide with an added checkpoint inhibitor (atezolizumab or durvalumab) in extensive-stage disease. Physician selects.

nodes.name: Relapsed SCLC
nodes.title: Relapsed SCLC: subsequent-line therapy
nodes.description: Subsequent-line therapy for relapsed small cell lung cancer. Physician selects.

nodes.name: Mesothelioma
nodes.title: Malignant pleural mesothelioma: systemic therapy
nodes.description: Unresectable/advanced malignant pleural mesothelioma: platinum-pemetrexed chemotherapy or nivolumab-ipilimumab immunotherapy. Physician selects.
